data.one_liner: Support library for accessing Objective C via ffigen in Flutter
data.what_it_does: Provides Dart wrappers and utilities for Objective C objects, handling memory management and stream conversion. It is intended to be used alongside ffigen-generated bindings.
use_when: You need to call Objective C APIs from Flutter
You are using ffigen to generate bindings for an Objective C library
You require efficient stream handling and memory safety for Objective C objects
avoid_when: You are not using ffigen or any Objective C code
You need a pure Dart solution for your platform
strengths: Performance improvements for stream and data conversion
weaknesses: Limited to platforms that support Objective C (iOS, macOS, Windows, Linux, Android)
